sentences.cn_text: 在过去十年里，数以千计的所谓商业方法专利被授予。
sentences.en_text: Over the past decade, thousands of patents have been granted for what are called business methods.

sentences.cn_text: 亚马逊公司因其「一键」在线支付系统获得了一项专利。
sentences.en_text: Amazon.com received one for its “one-click” online payment system.

sentences.cn_text: 美林公司为一项资产配置策略获得了法律保护。
sentences.en_text: Merrill Lynch got legal protection for an asset allocation strategy.

sentences.cn_text: 一位发明人为一种提箱技术申请了专利。
sentences.en_text: One inventor patented a technique for lifting a box.

sentences.cn_text: 如今，美国最高专利法院似乎已完全准备好缩减商业方法专利的授予规模，这类专利自十年前首次获得授权以来一直备受争议。
sentences.en_text: Now the nation’s top patent court appears completely ready to scale back on businessmethod patents, which have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago.

sentences.cn_text: 在一项引发知识产权律师热议的举措中，美国联邦巡回上诉法院表示将利用一个特定案件对商业方法专利进行全面审查。
sentences.en_text: In a move that has intellectual-property lawyers abuzz, the US Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit said it would use a particular case to conduct a broad review of businessmethod patents.

sentences.cn_text: 密苏里大学法学院的丹尼斯·D·克劳奇表示,这个被称为「比尔斯基案」的案件「是一件非常重大的事」。
sentences.en_text: In re Bilski, as the case is known, is “a very big deal,” says Dennis D. Crouch of the University of Missouri School of Law.

sentences.cn_text: 它「有可能消除整整一类专利」。
sentences.en_text: It “has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents.”

sentences.cn_text: 对商业方法专利申请的限制将是一次戏剧性的彻底转向,因为正是联邦巡回法院本身在1998年的所谓「州街银行案」判决中引入了此类专利,当时它批准了一项有关共同基金资产汇集方式的专利。
sentences.en_text: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets.

sentences.cn_text: 该裁决引发了商业方法专利申请的激增,最初申请者是新兴互联网公司,它们试图为特定类型的在线交易获取专有权。
sentences.en_text: That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions.

sentences.cn_text: 后来,更多老牌公司竞相将此类专利添加到自己的档案中,哪怕仅仅是为了防御可能抢先一步的竞争对手。
sentences.en_text: Later, more established companies raced to add such patents to their files, if only as a defensive move against rivals that might beat them to the punch.

sentences.cn_text: 2005年,IBM在一份法庭文件中指出,它已获得300多项商业方法专利,尽管它对授予这些专利的法律依据表示质疑。
sentences.en_text: In 2005, IBM noted in a court filing that it had been issued more than 300 business-method patents, despite the fact that it questioned the legal basis for granting them.

sentences.cn_text: 类似地,一些华尔街投资公司也为金融产品配备了专利,尽管它们在法庭案件中反对这种做法。
sentences.en_text: Similarly, some Wall Street investment firms armed themselves with patents for financial products, even as they took positions in court cases opposing the practice.

sentences.cn_text: 比尔斯基案涉及一项声称可在能源市场中对冲风险的方法专利。
sentences.en_text: The Bilski case involves a claimed patent on a method for hedging risk in the energy market.

sentences.cn_text: 联邦巡回法院发布了一项不同寻常的命令,声明该案将由法院全部12名法官审理,而非常规的三人合议庭,并且它希望评估的一个问题是是否应当「重新考虑」其在州街银行案中的裁决。
sentences.en_text: The Federal Circuit issued an unusual order stating that the case would be heard by all 12 of the court’s judges, rather than a typical panel of three, and that one issue it wants to evaluate is whether it should “reconsider” its State Street Bank ruling.

sentences.cn_text: 联邦巡回法院的此项举措是在最高法院近期一系列缩小专利持有人保护范围的判决之后作出的。
sentences.en_text: The Federal Circuit’s action comes in the wake of a series of recent decisions by the Supreme Court that has narrowed the scope of protections for patent holders.

sentences.cn_text: 例如,去年四月,大法官们指出,有太多显而易见的「发明」获得了专利维持。
sentences.en_text: Last April, for example, the justices signaled that too many patents were being upheld for “inventions” that are obvious.

sentences.cn_text: 乔治华盛顿大学法学院专利律师兼教授哈罗德·C·韦格纳表示,联邦巡回法院的法官们正在「对最高法院的反专利趋势作出反应」。
sentences.en_text: The judges on the Federal Circuit are “reacting to the anti-patent trend at the Supreme Court,” says Harold C. Wegner, a patent attorney and professor at George Washington University, Law School.

sentences.en_text: Business-method patents have recently aroused concern because of ____

sentences.en_text: the possible restriction on their granting.

sentences.cn_text: 关于其授权的争议
sentences.en_text: the controversy over their authorization.

sentences.cn_text: 关于比尔斯基案,以下哪项说法正确?
sentences.en_text: Which of the following is true of the Bilski case?

sentences.cn_text: 其裁决符合法院判决
sentences.en_text: Its ruling complies with the court decisions.

sentences.cn_text: 它涉及一项非常重大的商业交易
sentences.en_text: It involves a very big business transaction.

sentences.cn_text: 它已被联邦巡回法院驳回
sentences.en_text: It has been dismissed by the Federal Circuit.

sentences.cn_text: 它可能改变美国的法律实践
sentences.en_text: It may change the legal practices in the US.

sentences.en_text: are immune to legal challenges.

sentences.cn_text: 经常被不必要地授予
sentences.en_text: are often unnecessarily issued.

sentences.en_text: lower the esteem for patent holders.

sentences.en_text: Which of the following would be the subject of the text?

sentences.cn_text: 商业方法专利面临的迫在眉睫的威胁
sentences.en_text: A looming threat to the business-method patents.

sentences.cn_text: 对商业方法专利持有人的保护
sentences.en_text: Protection for business-method patent holders.

sentences.cn_text: 一起有关商业方法专利的法律案件
sentences.en_text: A legal case regarding business-method patents.

sentences.cn_text: 反对商业方法专利的普遍趋势
sentences.en_text: A prevailing trend against business-method patents.
